headline: Russian Arctic Oil Exports Jump Amid Global Shipping Route Shifts
summary: Russia's oil exports through the Northern Sea Route exceeded last year's volumes by nearly 50%, with approximately 20 million barrels shipped to Asia.
why: Shifts in international freight and energy shipping corridors alter global supply chains and influence regional commodity delivery costs.

impacts.name: Energy Shipping
impacts.why: Increased utilization of Arctic shipping routes boosts delivery volumes of Russian crude oil to Asian markets.
